name: dev-engineering
description: Software engineering delivery workflows for implementation, testing, debugging, review, request triage, architecture, and maintenance.

interface.longDescription: Dev Engineering delivers defined software work through implementation, test-driven development, debugging, code review, request triage, implementation-facing architecture, and codebase maintenance. Its router can hand product-definition and solution-design work to the independently installable Dev Productivity plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me implement, verify, debug, review, or maintain this software work.
